notes: Source tickers that measure the same instrument the dashboard prices for a symbol. A research reading keyed to any other ticker (SPX for SPY, RUT for IWM, gold spot for GLD) is a proxy and is labelled with its source instrument. Aliases in infra/lambdas/gmail_ingestor/research_entities.json route readings to a symbol; they do not make them the same instrument. rewrittenAtIngest lists publication keys the email parser files under an ETF ticker although the published range is for the underlying (infra/lambdas/gmail_ingestor/parse_hedgeye_email_html.py TICKER_MAP: GOLD → GLD, WTI → USO); such a range is a proxy for the ETF.
